description: Yongzhe (Kindred) Yi — human–robot interaction and robot learning at MIT CSAIL.
researchInterests: My research interests lie at the intersection of human–robot interaction (HRI) and robot learning. I want to build robots that understand people and align their behavior with human intent and preferences. My work spans shared control, dexterous teleoperation, and learning legible robot behavior.
